key_findings: No new clinical trials matching pediatric DMG H3K27M inclusion criteria identified beyond existing database (20 NCTs tracked).
No new development programs or regulatory updates detected for EGFR exon 20 insertion–specific DMG therapeutics.
BLU-5082 (Blueprint Medicines) brain-penetrant EGFR TKI remains in preclinical/early development phase; no new trial registration since last scan.
Dordaviprone FDA approval status unchanged; EGFR exon 20 insertion contraindication per SNO 2025 DMG-63 remains critical clinical consideration for this patient.
last_run_summary.scan_notes: Comprehensive search performed across ClinicalTrials.gov, EUCTR, PMDA/jRCT, PubMed (H3K27M 2025–2026), ASCO/SNO/SIOPE abstract databases, Israeli hospital trial registries (Sheba, Schneider, Hadassah, Rambam, Sourasky, Soroka, Rabin), WHO ICTRP, and cancer.org.il. No new NCTs or development IDs identified. All 20 known trials and 16 known developments remain current as of 2026-10-24. Recommendation: Continue monitoring BLU-5082 clinical development and EGFR exon 20 mutation–specific trial launches; coordinate with treating oncologist regarding dordaviprone eligibility given molecular profile.
